liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The reviewer identifies this track as one of the excellent moments in the performance [22]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): The second set features unique jams within the Help-Slip-Frank sequence, tearing it up [19]
- **One More Saturday Night** (1 review): The show concludes with a super high energy performance of this song, tying it together [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-10-01.170521.mtx.hunter.flac1644** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 172 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Clicks were removed from the soundboard source during this song and several others [1]
- **gd1976-10-01.sbd.miller.112800.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 150 min; rated 4.63/5 by 19 [4]. Said about its sound: A small patch in the recording does not degrade the overall quality of the track; The reviewer was surprised that the second set's audio quality matched the first set; The reviewer highlights the tight, fun performance and great interplay during this specific song [11][12][15]
- **gd1976-10-01.aud.unknown.118467.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 163 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [7]. Said about its sound: The reviewer praises the sound quality, noting it is very good despite mixed performance views [22]
- **gd1976-10-01.sbd.miller.111819.flac16**: soundboard; 12 songs; 73 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [10]

## Around the show

- Garcia's voice is described as sweet, Keith takes tonal risks, and Bobby maintains rhythm [15]
- The reviewer recalls childhood memories of seeing Neil Diamond and Billy Joel at the venue [16]
- The Market Square Arena was demolished, but the reviewer notes its significance for local fans [16]
- Weir pushed for a Dancing In The Streets reprise while Garcia worked on Stella Blue [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-10-01.170521.mtx.hunter.flac1644**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC & SHN > AIFF > Final Cut > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)… [1]. Also: Jerry Moore's preserved recording adds significant duration between songs, including tuning sections and audience commentary [1]
- **gd1976-10-01.sbd.miller.112800.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD [4]. Also: Charlie Miller provided the first available soundboard copy of the second set [11]
- **gd1976-10-01.aud.unknown.118467.flac2496**: taped by Unknown; source: SRC: Unknown AUD (likely FOB); [7]
- **gd1976-10-01.sbd.miller.111819.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD [10]. Also: The recording originated from discs provided by Mr. Gans and transferred by Mr. Miller [14]
